_comment: Provider framework for Oldowan. 'active' picks the provider. Two wire formats cover nearly everything: 'anthropic' (Messages API) and 'openai' (chat/completions, which also covers Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Together, Gemini's OpenAI endpoint, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM...). 'mock' is a scripted provider for testing the whole flow with no key. ${VARS} are expanded from secrets.json first, then the environment.
_timeout_comment: Sketch generation is streamed, so request_timeout_s is now the gap allowed BETWEEN chunks rather than a ceiling on the whole turn - a turn may legitimately run longer than this. It must still stay BELOW nginx's proxy_read_timeout for lith.vidalion.co/api/ or nginx 504s first and the user sees a raw gateway error instead of Oldowan's own message. guard_timeout_s covers the small guard_model calls only.

anthropic._max_tokens_comment: Thinking is ON BY DEFAULT on sonnet-5 and shares this budget with the reply. At 24000 the build turn spent ~23900 on thinking and got cut off after ~60 tokens of the envelope, so every sketch died as truncated JSON. Keep plenty of headroom above the biggest sketch, and use effort (not budget_tokens, which is a 400 on this model) to control how deep it thinks.
